lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: I have inspected the perimeter and found the towers and ramparts secure, though the moat is still incomplete for our high ground defense.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We should be able to repel any assault this rabble can muster.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius. It appears that three different tribes are part of this attack.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their advance is disorganized and they have little knowledge of formation, but the fact that they are cooperating is cause for concern.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The tribesmen host has broken and their survivors scatter into the wood to carry the tune of their defeat.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Your fortress is strong, Commander. Within the week, when the moat is complete and inner ring of towers raised, this position of strength will safeguard our coastal settlements from any harm.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Victory! VICTORY! Hail Varius, blessed be his name!

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Sir Varius will be recorded in imperial history as the general that stood against the combined might of the Hunewold and tore it asunder.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: This is a shining day for you and the Empire.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius, I come with word just delivered from our far watch patrol.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: A horde of Hunewold tribesmen, of a size greater than any met during the first conquest, has emerged from the east.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The tribes have united under a single war leader, Armagni, with the sole purpose of raiding and burning all imperial settlements in the Hunewold.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their first hammer stroke will fall upon our fortress here. It will be up to us to turn the tide or be swept away under their onslaught.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: By the gods! The very trees sway with the stamp of their approach!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: My apologies, my lord. The men are ready and the fortress sound. Lead us through this terror to victory and the Hunewold is the Empire's once more.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Victory! VICTORY! Hail Varius, blessed be his name!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius will be recorded in imperial history as the general that stood against the combined might of the Hunewold and tore it asunder.

lines.speaker: Field Officer

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Setting fire to these huts will draw their scouts to investigate.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Word will spread among their tribes that Carrone has returned to the Rukiev. We should expect the Horselords' reprisal to be swift and fierce.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: You have the Emperor's trust and favor, Sir Varius.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The honor of leading the army that will first face the Horselords has been given to you.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: As we march east and draw their fury upon us, Duke Stokeshire and Viscount Anston will land ships upon the Mirror Sea coast and retake our first settlement.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Attacking this small encampment will be the spark that ignites the Horselords' ire. We must keep them blind to our fleet if they are to land safely.

lines.speaker: Field Officer

lines.speaker: Field Officer

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: The size of their force was smaller than expected. This could not have been their full strength.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Let us hope this was only a feint to test us. If their main host is not upon the plain when our fleet lands, our allies will be lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two days since our attack upon their camp and still no counter from the Horselords.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Their attention must be fixed upon us for our landing at the Mirror Sea to be successful.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Varius! Horselords riding hard from the west!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: REGROUP! They seek to strike at the rear flanks of our column!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Let us hope this was only a feint to test us. If their main host is not upon the plain when our fleet lands, our allies will be lost.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: My Lord, your Grace, when no word arrived of your landing we feared the worst.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Our apologies to you, Sir Varius. Your attacks were successful in luring the Horselord host away from the Mirror Sea, but we were delayed in crossing Mare Nostra.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Aye, strange storm winds from the east nearly closed the narrows to us. Only a third of the fleet actually made the landing, we do not yet know the full extent of our losses.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: There will be a time to mourn the dead. For now, let us celebrate the living.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Come, friends. Let us find a skin of wine to share while Sir Varius tells us of his campaign across the Rukiev!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The Horselords have arrived in strength, Sir Varius. Our scouts estimate they have nearly twice our number.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: With still no messenger from our allies, we must assume that the fleet has been lost.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Our few against their many, we shall give them such a battle that will not long be forgotten.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We fight for Sir Varius! We fight for the Emperor! WE FIGHT FOR CARRONE!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Warhorns! Warhorns from the east!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: By the grace of the Emperor...!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: And for the glory of Carrone!

victoryLines.text: Sir Varius, the road ahead is cleared.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: We should make haste to the Wizard's Palace.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, the squall during the sea crossing has swept some of our ships off course.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Our small detachment will have to march eastward alone. The Emperor has ordered us to proceed with all possible haste to the Wizard's Palace.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Sir Anston and the remainder of your forces can rejoin with us there.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We're under attack!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, two small squads of fighters have been sighted in the surrounding forest...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: How could they have learned of our arrival so quickly?

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Those fighters were no match for us. Let us continue onwards.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Ambush!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Why are there so many hostiles this close to the Wizard's Palace?

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Let's move east and not delay any longer on the cursed road.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Looks like someone is guarding the road up ahead.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: I doubt they will let us pass without a fight.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Travelling by warp portal always leaves me with a queasy feeling. But it beats getting impaled!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, look to the east - the Wizard's Palace is being assaulted!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: They are unaware of our approach - we may be able to surprise them and take out their rear flank.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We'll need to fight our way through the warp portals on top of those dunes...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: ... to the south...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: ... and north.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: The portals will warp us to the Palace interior. We should be safe inside the Wizard's Palace.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, enemy reinforcements have arrived! We're severely overmatched - we must escape through the warp portals or we will surely perish!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Our numberse are dwindling, we need to reach those warp portals now!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: If we lose another man, we will be overrun. This is our last chance to escape through the warp portals.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: There are too few of us left. We were... so close...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: At least one of us has made it safely inside the palace Commander.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: At least... I think that's where he went...

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Now let's get the rest of our detachment through the warp portals.

victoryLines.speaker: Dark Sorcerer
victoryLines.text: We are indebted to you and the Empire for your help this day!

victoryLines.text: I don't understand it Commander, why would anyone be trying to attack the Wizard's Palace?

victoryLines.text: That's partially the reason you are here. Not only has the Wizard's Palace been coming under regular assaults as of late...

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: The villagers are safe for now. Their Craftsmen shouldn't have trouble repairing the damage caused by the bandits.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Sir Anston, take a look at this! One of the bandits was carrying a message...

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: ...it reads as a directive for these bandits to join an attack on some city known as Caladrin.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Hmm... Caladrin is a large city not far from here.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Sir Varius, there's no way for us to know how long ago this message was sent...

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: We must hurry north and warn the good people of Caladrin before it's too late!

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, these hilltop villages are under attack!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: These must be the bandits the Wizards warned us about.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: It's a good thing the lost ships carrying reinforcements were able to rejoin with us after the battle at the Wizard's Palace.

lines.speaker: War Advisor

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Let's show these lawless bandits the wrath of the Empire!

defeatLines.speaker: Field Officer

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: It is as I feared Varius. Caladrin has already sustained some damage from the assault.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Varius these villagers we rescued have agreed to join our cause. Among them are some talented Craftsmen.

lines.speaker: Desert Chieftain
lines.text: It is my honor to serve the Emperor. Caladrin is home to many families, including my own - we should not delay!

lines.speaker: War Advisor

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: We must escort them safely inside the city.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Yeah, but how do we get there?

lines.text: This desert is our domain. You are not welcome here.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, those Dune Sirens are using their magic to create Quicksand!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: I do not see an alternate route, we'll have to pass through it.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: More of the cursed Dune Sirens ahead!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Two more portals ahead... but which one do we use?

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, one of the Craftsmen has been slain!

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: We must ensure that at least two Craftsmen reach the city interior to help repair the Caladrin defenses.

victoryLines.text: We must inform the Emperor and the Wizard's Palace that Martin Landower remains a threat!

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: ...I wonder what he hoped to gain by attacking this peaceful city?

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: Commander, I have just learned from the city elders that Caladrin is the resting place of a secret treasure.

victoryLines.speaker: Field Officer
victoryLines.text: It appears to be some type of ancient scroll. I wonder what it says.

victoryLines.speaker: War Advisor
victoryLines.text: Varius, I shall send a messenger to the Wizard's Palace at once. I'd bet my last gold piece they can decipher this scroll's meaning.

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Curses! I thought I had seen the last of you when I evaded capture in Sangsoleil.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Martin Landower?? What in blazes are you doing out here?

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Just running an errand for someone. If you are as wise as I remember, you'll stay out of my way.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Do not be blinded by your own greed Landower!

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Break off this assault and the Emperor may go lightly on you.

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: Haha! Greed no longer motivates me... only power!

lines.speaker: Enemy Commander
lines.text: If you want to help these people tell them to open the city gates!

lines.speaker: Landower's Forces
lines.text: Varius, I see you're determined to defend this city...

lines.speaker: Landower's Forces
lines.text: No matter, you've not seen the full power of the forces I command!

lines.speaker: Landower's Forces
lines.text: These Conjurers will have me inside Caladrin by nightfall whether you like it or not.

lines.speaker: Landower's Forces
lines.text: Bring down the walls men! Caladrin falls today! Bring the item to me when it is done.

lines.speaker: Landower's Forces
lines.text: Commander, Landower is fleeing the battle!

lines.text: ...and to the northeast! Another of those blasted Conjurers is with them!

lines.text: From the top of this large dune we should be able to see most of the surrounding lands.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Ugh, these endless patrols in the desert have turned up no signs of Landower so far.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Marching through this sandy wasteland is not my idea of a pleasant afternoon.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: If you had done as much scouting as you have complaining we might have found Landower by now.

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Commander, what manner of creature is that? They look hungry.

lines.text: Commander, Landower has somehow tamed these Blood Gorgers so they will fight for him.

lines.speaker: War Advisor
lines.text: Let's cut down these foul beasts!

lines.speaker: Field Officer

lines.speaker: Field Officer
lines.text: Perhaps we should deploy them down the hillside and get some Quicksand in front of those leeches.

lines.text: Those Blood Gorgers are getting stronger as they feed.

lines.text: ...that's just disgusting.
